from itertools import accumulate
from math import gcd


def best_average(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    prefix = [0]
    prefix.extend(accumulate(a))

    hull: list[int] = []
    head = 0
    best_num = -1
    best_den = 1

    for j in range(k, len(a) + 1):
        c = j - k
        pc = prefix[c]
        while len(hull) - head >= 2:
            a_idx = hull[-2]
            b_idx = hull[-1]
            if (prefix[b_idx] - prefix[a_idx]) * (c - b_idx) >= (pc - prefix[b_idx]) * (b_idx - a_idx):
                hull.pop()
            else:
                break
        hull.append(c)

        pj = prefix[j]
        while len(hull) - head >= 2:
            h0 = hull[head]
            h1 = hull[head + 1]
            if (pj - prefix[h1]) * (j - h0) >= (pj - prefix[h0]) * (j - h1):
                head += 1
            else:
                break

        i = hull[head]
        num = pj - prefix[i]
        den = j - i
        if num * best_den > best_num * den:
            best_num = num
            best_den = den

    g = gcd(best_num, best_den)
    return [best_num // g, best_den // g]
